title: Approval Status
description: Schema for tracking approval state of any content item, ad, reply, or CRM sequence in FnB OS V1. RULES: Published requires prior Approved. Scheduled requires prior Approved. Ad spend requires Approved. Auto-reply requires Approved. Only Owner can set Approved.

item_id.description: ID of the item being tracked. References content_id, brief_id, ads_pack_id, sequence_id, or reply_id.

approval_status.description: Current approval state. Only Owner can advance to Approved.

owner_decision.description: Owner's explicit decision. Only Owner can set Approved. Null if no decision yet.

reviewer.description: Name or ID of the reviewer who checked this item before Owner.

review_notes.description: Notes from the reviewer. Required if owner_decision is Needs Revision or Rejected.

approved_at.description: Datetime when Owner set Approved. Required before Scheduled or Published can be set.

scheduled_at.description: Datetime scheduled for publishing. Requires prior Approved state and non-null approved_at.

published_at.description: Datetime when item was published. Requires prior Approved state and non-null approved_at.

change_log.description: Ordered list of status changes with timestamps and actors.

by.description: Agent or human who made this status change.
